hero.backgroundImageNote: ART DIRECTION CHANGE. The original masthead (sp1-17.jpg) is a close-up of a goat behind a wire fence at 1024×724 — unusable as a cinematic fullscreen hero. Replaced with ku1574-dsc06647.jpg, the only genuinely high-resolution asset on the site (4000×6000): sharp at every viewport, natively portrait for mobile, and an olive grove reads unmistakably as Crete. whyUs.title: Pick up & Travelling
whyUs.text:
Pickup from your villa with our VIP van.
Every vehicle is equipped with a TV and A/C to make your trip comfortable.

whyUs.title: Local Knowledge & Personal Approach
whyUs.text: We know the roads, the stories, the people. Every route is designed with care, adapted to your pace, your interests, and your curiosity.

whyUs.title: Comfort, Safety & Genuine Hospitality
whyUs.text: Exploring should feel relaxed. We make sure you travel comfortably, safely, and with the warm Cretan hospitality that makes every journey memorable.

howToBook.imageNote: Single 160×160 image reused for all 5 steps on the original site. See CONTENT_INVENTORY.md Q10.

steps.title: Explore Our Excursions
steps.body: Browse our available routes and experiences. Each excursion includes detailed information about locations, duration, and what’s included — so you can choose the one that fits your interests best.

steps.title: Choose Your Preferred Date
steps.body: Select the date that works for you and check availability.

steps.title: Send Us Your Details
steps.titleOriginal: We’ll respond promptly with availability, final details, and booking confirmation.
steps.titleFlag: CORRECTED. The live site's heading was a copy-paste of step 4's body and did not describe this step. Replacement supplied by the client. Body is unchanged and verbatim. See CONTENT_INVENTORY.md §4.4 / Q1.

• Preferred date
